description:
Manage Digital Product Passports — create, read, run compliance checks. Archive, suspend, place on market and record_registration are in tracepass_passport_lifecycle.

IMPORTANT: `create` makes a DRAFT passport: no plan DPP slot, never billed. The slot, and any overage past the plan cap, is taken when it is published in the TracePass dashboard, not through this tool. Each create counts against the daily write budget.

EU DPP REGISTRY (battery): the operator registers a passport itself, on the Registry website under its own EU Login. TracePass prepares what it submits and records what it reports; it never submits to the Registry and never verifies the outcome. The acceptance environment has no legal effect; production is recorded with record_registration (tracepass_passport_lifecycle). Paid plan; an OAuth app must act for an admin or owner.

Identifier schemes (EN 18219): gs1 | iso15459 | iec61406 | did | doi; batteries accept ONLY gs1 and iso15459. Shapes, lineage, snapshots, measurements, refusal codes: resource tracepass://reference/passports.

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object). Read-only unless marked WRITE. A *_by_serial action takes { serial, gtin? } instead of `id` (on 409 ambiguous_serial pass `gtin`).
- list — { page?, limit? (≤100), productId?, status?, search? }. status ∈ draft|in_review|approved|published|suspended|expired|archived.
- get, get_by_serial — { id, format? (summary|full), lang? }.
- compliance — { id }. compliant | compliant_with_warnings | incomplete, with regulation-cited findings and byRegulation[]. A regulation absent from byRegulation raised no finding, which is not the same as passed.
- registry_readiness — { id }. Battery only. { ready, findings[] }: the Registry's FORMAL pre-submission check, not the compliance verdict.
- prepare_registry_upi — { id }. WRITE, battery, published only. { upi, preparedAt } for the operator to paste into the Registry form. Submits nothing.
- prepare_registry_upload_file — { passportIds (1–100) }. WRITE, battery. { xml, filename, included, excluded }: the operator uploads `xml` on the Registry website; TracePass does not. 1 write per included passport.
- record_acceptance_test — { id, result: passed|failed, errorCode? }. WRITE, battery, published only. Records what the operator reports from the ACCEPTANCE environment: no legal effect, not verified. Undo: undo_registration (acceptance).
- create — { productId, identifier?, gtin?, serialNumber?, lineage? }. Draft, not billed. identifier preferred, or legacy gtin + serialNumber. Battery: only gs1/iso15459, else 400. Duplicate: 409. lineage (battery): a repurposed, remanufactured or reused battery needs a NEW passport linked to the original(s) (Art. 77(7)); immutable after create.
- get_qr, get_qr_by_serial — { id, format? (svg|png), symbology? (qr|datamatrix) }. One passport's QR; the bare GTIN URL is the product's model page (see products get_links).
- list_snapshots — { id, page?, limit?, at? (ISO 8601) }; get_snapshot — { id, snapshotId }. EN 18221 change archive (`at` = the snapshot valid then). Entries carry contentHash, hashMethod (jcs-sha256 = RFC 8785 + SHA-256; older: sorted-json-sha256), previousHash and, in the list, chainLink plus a chain verdict. 1 read each.
- get_condition_flags, _by_serial — { id }. Approved yes/no facts that gate conditional duties; an approved flag can make fields required and block publish. 1 read.
- set_condition_flags, _by_serial — { id, flags: Record<flagKey, boolean|null> }. WRITE; null clears. WARNING: approving a flag can make fields required and block publishing if empty — fix them before or right after.
- capture_measurements, _by_serial — { id, measurements: [ { fieldKey, value, measuredAt (ISO 8601), externalId?, unit? } ] (≤500) }. WRITE, battery, published only. Over-life data from the customer's equipment; metered against the monthly measurement allowance, not the write budget.
- list_measurements, _by_serial — { id, fieldKey?, from?, to?, limit? (≤200), cursor? }; latest_measurements, _by_serial — { id }. Read-only.

gtin.description: Legacy GS1 GTIN (create), or the disambiguator for *_by_serial.
